Tomato___Early_blight.description: A common fungal leaf disease that begins as brown spots with concentric rings, usually on older leaves.
recommended_actions: Use a locally approved fungicide according to label instructions or agricultural officer guidance if disease progresses
Tomato___Early_blight.when_to_contact_expert: Contact an agricultural officer if spots spread rapidly, fruit is affected, or the crop does not improve after sanitation.

Tomato___Late_blight.description: A rapidly spreading disease that can damage leaves, stems, and fruit during cool, wet conditions.
recommended_actions: Isolate and remove badly affected plants
Tomato___Late_blight.when_to_contact_expert: Contact an agricultural officer promptly because late blight can spread very quickly.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.description: A moisture-favored fungal disease often seen as yellow patches above and olive growth below leaves.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.when_to_contact_expert: Seek advice if symptoms continue spreading after moisture is controlled.

Tomato___healthy.description: No common disease pattern was strongly detected in this image.
Tomato___healthy.when_to_contact_expert: Consult an expert if the plant has symptoms not clearly visible in the image.

Potato___Early_blight.description: A leaf disease marked by dark concentric lesions, commonly affecting stressed or older plants.
Potato___Early_blight.when_to_contact_expert: Contact an officer if lesions reach stems or spread across the plot.

Potato___Late_blight.description: A serious, fast-moving disease of potato leaves and tubers, favored by wet weather.

Rice___Brown_spot.description: A fungal disease causing oval brown lesions, often more visible where plant nutrition or water management is poor.
Rice___Brown_spot.when_to_contact_expert: Seek advice when spots are widespread or panicles are affected.

Rice___Leaf_blast.description: A potentially serious rice disease producing spindle-shaped lesions and crop loss under favorable conditions.
recommended_actions: Consult a local officer about approved management
Rice___Leaf_blast.when_to_contact_expert: Contact an agricultural officer promptly if lesions spread or reach the neck/panicle.

Groundnut___Leaf_spot.description: A fungal leaf-spot complex that can cause premature leaf fall and reduce pod development.
recommended_actions: Seek approved local management guidance if spreading
Groundnut___Leaf_spot.when_to_contact_expert: Seek help if defoliation becomes noticeable or the crop is young.
